products.name: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint Integration — Commercial
products.short_description: Auto-onboard EDR and turn device risk into access control. Wire up Defender + Intune yourself with self-guided, tested steps — far cheaper than consulting.
products.description:
Full EDR coverage with automatic onboarding and risk-based access

Antivirus alone does not stop a modern attacker. Microsoft Defender for Endpoint adds endpoint detection and response, behavioral protection, and a live device risk score — and when you integrate it with Intune, devices onboard automatically and that risk score flows straight into compliance and Conditional Access, so a compromised device loses access on its own.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant on site to deploy Microsoft Defender for Endpoint Integration. This package hands you the exact, field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation that a non-expert administrator can follow from start to finish — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell scripts that do the heavy lifting. You implement with confidence, on your own schedule, and keep the playbook forever.

  • Simpler — exact navigation in the right order, written for a novice admin. Click to implement; the “why” lives in the overview so the steps stay short and uncluttered.
  • Cheaper — one fixed, transparent price instead of an open meter. A comparable consulting engagement runs $1,500–$3,000 per day across several days; this is a fraction of that, with nothing left to bill.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with validation scripts and clear pass/fail gates, so you know it worked before you roll out to the fleet.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — how the Intune ↔ Defender integration works end to end.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (including licensing) with verify/implement steps.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps across the Defender portal and Intune: connector, EDR onboarding policy, and risk-into-compliance.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — onboarding discovery, sensor validation, tenant reporting, safe remediation, and connector status.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with pass/fail gates, plus Best Practices.

The Phoenixtekk way

Every Phoenixtekk solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each one you deploy feels familiar and low-risk — and your team gets faster and more confident with every rollout. Buy once, deploy to unlimited devices, and reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Automatic EDR onboarding for the whole fleet and a risk score wired into access control — compromised devices are flagged and cut off automatically, all managed from a single pane.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • MDE-ConnectorCheck.ps1 — confirm the Intune ↔ Defender for Endpoint connector is active (Graph)
    • MDE-Discovery.ps1 — Defender for Endpoint onboarding readiness check
    • MDE-Remediation.ps1 — safe remediation for Defender for Endpoint onboarding/sensor issues
    • MDE-TenantReport.ps1 — tenant-wide Defender for Endpoint device health + risk report (Graph)
    • MDE-Validation.ps1 — confirm Defender for Endpoint onboarding and sensor health

Delivered as a branded Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse across unlimited devices.
